reserveReview.rationale: At RISE block 24455282 (2026-10-15T10:44:01Z), the extension held 4,191,272.318305 M against 4,166,891.817608 USDR, and JMI totalAssets() was zero. Token and facility EIP-1967 implementations remain 0xf9733d0bf530b02929ab81cf78e7d0befd3a2d7b and 0xf7f9638cb444d65e5a40bf5ff98ebe4ff319f04e; both runtimes match the explorer verified bytecode. For unprivileged sample address 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001, canSwapViaPath(USDR,wM) returned true and canSwapViaPath(USDR,M) returned false. The former is an extension-to-extension conversion; direct M output requires approved-swapper status. These eligibility reads establish neither a completed transaction, same-notional output capacity nor a cash redemption right. No non-M reserve slice is assigned because totalAssets() is zero. Parent-token inventory is a technical custody observation, not independent upstream financial assurance; accrued M yield can be claimed for RISE.
